items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-07
items.q: we had a clown at play with Zeb Lonerese.

ctx.x: When you had the lead. Yeah. Right. Take the melody, right. Take it the way you want. But in those days, would most of your pieces be, would the melody line be held by the trumpet or by you on the trombone?

No, the most by the trumpet. By the trumpet. We used the cornet at that time, see? Cornet. But the trumpet wasn't famous when I was playing. I see. So I wouldn't know what to tell you, how the trumpet and trombone were together, you see? Right. Well… But I know plenty of times we played a plenty of lead, and I liked the tune we used to play. Marilyn, the giga-cow. That had a fine trombone solo in that, you see? Yeah. Bum-bum-bum-bum-bum-bum-bum-bum. That's a good trombone solo, you see? Just played. And many…
And he had a very good ear for catching from the records, you see?
